summary: Backend (34 pytest tests) + frontend Playwright flow covering notifications, report downloads (CSV/PDF), role playground (all 5 roles), QR scan manual lookup, asset detail QR panel, blank-name validators, theme toggle, and RBAC sidebar rendering. All backend endpoints pass. Notifications drawer, role preview modal, downloads, and scan flow work end-to-end. One frontend UX defect found: FastAPI 422 validation errors surface as a toast reading '[object Object]' because data.detail is an array of objects rather than a string.

ui_bugs.issue: When backend returns HTTP 422 (Pydantic validation error) with detail as an array of objects, the toast displays literally '[object Object]'. This happens on blank/whitespace admin department/category, blank booking purpose, blank audit fields. User cannot understand the rejection reason.
ui_bugs.selector: toast (see screenshot: Admin console blank department submit)

action_items: Update api() error handler in /app/frontend/src/App.js: if data.detail is an array, join msgs (e.g. `Array.isArray(data.detail) ? data.detail.map(d => d.msg).join('; ') : data.detail`). This will surface useful messages like 'Department name must be at least 2 non-blank characters'.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 1007 lines and contains all screens, modals, drawers, contexts — consider splitting per-route to keep changes safe.
Notifications drawer auto-fires POST /notifications/mark-all-read the moment it opens (App.js line 166); there is no explicit control to keep something unread. Acceptable for MVP but worth noting.
Duplicate accreditation download buttons exist on both /reports and /admin — both wired to same endpoint; consider a shared helper to avoid drift.
seed_data_creation: During testing created a TEST_NOTIF high-priority maintenance and a TEST_NOTIF booking so the notifications feed had content; a TEST_UI_* department was also added via the UI. All TEST_* data was deleted from MongoDB after the run (departments, categories, bookings, audits, maintenance, and the residual 'Browser Test Asset' from a prior iteration).
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — admin@assetflow.edu / Admin123! (Admin), demo@assetflow.edu / Campus123! (Asset Manager).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL from frontend/.env is used throughout. Notifications feed is empty when no unresolved high-priority maintenance, no upcoming bookings (<=3 days), no pending users, no open audits — seed something to see items. Backend validators reject blank/whitespace and <2-char-after-trim names on departments/categories/audits/bookings and return 422; frontend toast currently mangles that response, see action_items.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of '[object Object]' toast: In App.js `api()` helper (line ~18) `throw new Error(data.detail || 'Something went wrong')`. For FastAPI validation errors, `data.detail` is a list of ValidationError dicts, so coercion yields '[object Object]'. Fix by normalising the detail before wrapping into Error.
